headline: Mold-Tek Packaging allots over 3.32 crore bonus securities
hook: Bonus shares credited to eligible shareholders
summary: Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has allotted 3,32,28,914 securities following its bonus issue on October 12, 2026. This corporate action increases the total number of shares issued by the company. Shareholders on the record date receive these additional shares without any extra cost. Existing retail investors will see their shareholding count increase proportionately.
why_it_matters: Bonus shares increase your holdings without altering total investment value

headline: GIFT Nifty signals positive start; key stocks in focus
summary: The GIFT Nifty indicates a gain of 72 points for the Indian markets on Friday, October 9. Investors are tracking several companies including TCS, ITC, Lupin, Hexaware Tech, and JSW Steel. Other stocks in focus include IRB Infra, NCC, Anand Rathi Wealth, and Mold-Tek Packaging. These movements reflect early sentiment ahead of the trading session.
why_it_matters: Positive market opening expected for key large and mid-cap stocks.
